title: The Chinese bahaba, a critically endangered fish nicknamed the 'Panda of the Sea,' was missing from Hong Kong for over a decade, until its DNA gave it away
summary: The Chinese bahaba, a critically endangered fish known as the 'Panda of the Sea,' had not been recorded in Hong Kong for more than a decade. Recent DNA analysis identified the species' presence, offering a crucial lead for conservationists and highlighting the role of genetic forensics in tracking and protecting rare marine species.
